title: VIN Validator
description: Validates a 17-character Vehicle Identification Number using the ISO 3779 transliteration table and mod-11 check digit from wegolook/vin-validator. Spaces, hyphens, and surrounding whitespace are ignored; letters are case-insensitive. Returns validity, the normalized VIN, WMI, VDS, check digit (actual and expected), VIS, model year code, plant code, and serial. I, O, and Q are illegal. Invalid input returns valid:false with error and message.

vin.description: Vehicle Identification Number. Spaces, hyphens, and surrounding whitespace are ignored.
